Versus last year, adjusted second quarter earnings were down $1.1 billion. Adjusted upstream earnings were flat. Higher realizations and liftings were mostly offset with higher DD&A due to the PDC acquisition and the absence of prior year favorable tax items. Adjusted downstream earnings decreased mainly due to lower refining margins and higher turnaround in transportation OpEx. The other segment was down primarily due to state tax adjustments.
